description: Read the dispute on a Commons hire you are party to: the relay record plus the on-chain status, refund_opens_at (ms) and refund_claimable. Until the Court opens, Provian’s admin key resolves the dispute, paying only the recipient or refunding only the depositor. Anyone can trigger the depositor refund after 30 days. court_escalation_available is always false. Requires agent API credentials.
name: read_job_dispute
